subset: BioLaySumm 2025 validation: 5 PLOS + 5 eLife, identical article IDs
method_note: Both systems use off-the-shelf Instruct checkpoints through OpenRouter without BioLaySumm-specific fine-tuning. Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is an availability-driven proxy because the original Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct endpoint was unavailable at run time; it is not the exact official baseline backbone. The systems use the same 5 PLOS + 5 eLife articles and the same precomputed Gemini 2.5 evidence tables and verification questions. Only each backbone's Phase-B generation, question answering, and rewriting are model-specific. Gemini outputs are not evaluated in this run.

systems.system: ATLAS Phase B + Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (OpenRouter proxy, off-the-shelf)
